Catalog & Equipment

Trailer and truck capacity classes

Drilling rigs from 300m to 3000m, API Spec 5D drill pipes, and IADC tricone bits.

🚜 Trailer Rig 1500–3000 m · 110 t Mast

KD-3000 Heavy Trailer-Mounted Rotary Drilling Rig (1500–3000 m)

The KD-3000 is an ultra-heavy-duty rotary drilling rig engineered for deep aquifers (1500–3000 m / 4,920–9,840 ft), geothermal reservoir exploitation, and deep stratigraphic exploration. Featuring a certified 110-metric-ton mast hook-load and a 90-metric-ton heavy-duty drawworks, this rig effortlessly handles heavy drill collar strings, large-diameter casings, and extreme formation loads.

Specs & Quote →
🚜 Trailer Rig 2500 m · 14.50 m / 8 mm Mast

KD-2500 Special Deep Rotary Drilling Rig (2500 m)

Engineered for uncompromising reliability in remote and severe geological conditions, the KD-2500 special rig features dual MAN 422 diesel power units delivering redundant torque, a 14.50-meter reinforced mast, and a heavy 7.5×10 duplex mud pump for continuous 2500-meter drilling operations.

Specs & Quote →
🚚 Truck Rig 1000–1200 m · 90 t Mast

KD-1200 Truck-Mounted Rotary Drilling Rig (1000–1200 m)

Combining heavy-duty deep drilling power with self-propelled mobility, the KD-1200 truck-mounted rotary rig delivers 1200-meter drilling capability powered by a 422 HP deck engine, 90-ton mast capacity, and standard integrated mud pumps for municipal water and mining exploration.

Specs & Quote →
🚜 Trailer Rig 1000–1200 m · 110 t Mast

KD-1200-T Trailer-Mounted Heavy Drilling Rig (1000–1200 m)

Engineered on a multi-axle semi-trailer platform, the KD-1200-T delivers high structural rigidity, 110-ton mast capacity, and 525 HP power for demanding 1200-meter deep well programs.

Specs & Quote →
🚚 Truck Rig 800 m · 70 t Mast

KD-800 Truck-Mounted Drilling Rig (800 m)

The KD-800 provides dependable 800-meter rotary drilling capacity on a maneuverable truck chassis, powered by a 361 HP diesel engine and equipped with integrated mud pumping for irrigation and industrial water supply.

🚜 Trailer Rig 800 m · 70 t Mast

KD-800-T Trailer-Mounted Drilling Rig (800 m)

Mounted on a heavy semi-trailer, the KD-800-T provides a rigid 70-ton mast and 361 HP diesel unit for reliable 800-meter drilling.

🚚 Truck Rig 300–500 m · 60 t Mast

KD-500 Truck-Mounted Fast Drilling Rig (300–500 m)

Designed for rapid deployment on rural and urban job sites, the KD-500 offers 300–500 meter rotary drilling capacity with 321 HP engine power and a 60-ton mast.

🚜 Trailer Rig 400–600 m · 60 t Mast

KD-600-T Trailer-Mounted Drilling Rig (400–600 m)

A sturdy trailer platform providing 400–600 meter drilling depth, 60-ton mast hook-load, and 321 HP diesel power.

⚙️ Drill Pipes 2 3/8" – 5 1/2" · E, X, G, S Mast

API Spec 5D Heavy Duty Drill Pipes (2 3/8" – 5 1/2")

KD Sondaj supplies certified API Spec 5D rotary drill pipes from 2 3/8" to 5 1/2" OD in steel grades E-75 through S-135, engineered for high torsional resistance and tensile strength in deep water well, geothermal, and petroleum drilling.

Specs & Quote →
⭐ Drill Bits IADC 111 – 637 · 3 7/8" – 26" Mast

IADC Tricone Rotary Rock Drill Bits (111 – 637)

KD Sondaj supplies heavy-duty IADC tricone roller cone drill bits ranging from soft-formation milled tooth bits (IADC 111–217) to high-wear tungsten carbide insert (TCI) bits (IADC 517–637) with sealed journal bearings for extended bit life.

Specs & Quote →
💧 Mud Pump 6" Stroke / 62 Bar · 2 Piston / Double Acting Mast

KD 6" Duplex Drilling Mud Pump (21–62 Bar)

The KD 6" duplex reciprocating mud pump is engineered for continuous borehole mud circulation in deep water well, geothermal, and exploratory drilling. Featuring double-acting twin pistons, cast iron housing, and interchangeable liners from 3" to 5", it delivers operating pressures up to 62 bar (895 psi).

FAQ

Direct answers

What depths does KD Sondaj work at?

Corporate borehole capacity is 250–3000 metres. Catalogue headings use 300–3000 metres. The geothermal reference scope lists 1200–2600 m.

Which services does KD Sondaj provide?

Petroleum drilling, water well drilling, soil study, observation wells, mineral core drilling, geotechnical survey, geothermal drilling, and water search and locating.

Which rigs are used for geothermal drilling?

For high depth the catalogue shows the 1500–3000 m trailer, 1000–1200 m truck/trailer and the 2500 m special build. Final choice follows formation and mast load.

How is rig capacity chosen?

Target depth, carrier type (trailer/truck), mast and drawworks hook-load, and mud hydraulics are calculated collectively according to engineering standards.

What information is needed for a water-well project?

Target depth, well purpose, province and formation notes if known. Phone or email is enough; the site does not store a form.

Which regions does KD Sondaj serve from Ankara?

Headquarters are in Çankaya / Ankara. Operational range covers DSI regional basins, Aegean and Central Anatolia geothermal fields, and international overseas projects.
